data.name: My Monsters
data.detailed_description:
My Monsters is an action-adventure VR game that with a 100% hand-painted art, creating a visually stunning world full of fantasy and surrealism. At the heart of the game is a deep narrative that explores humanity's greatest inner struggles—anxiety, fear, and loneliness. As a player, you are transported to Onirium, a dream-like realm where you meet Moti, a frightened little monster with no memory.

In My Monsters, you’re never alone. Team up with your inner monster, Moti, to face a variety of enemies, solve intricate puzzles, and overcome challenges in a shared journey. This partnership mechanic fosters a powerful connection with Moti, requiring empathy and courage to navigate obstacles and reveal fragments of a meaningful dreamlike tale. Every stage introduces new aspects of this bond, allowing players to experience moments of self-discovery and emotional depth.

Key Features:

⚔️ Combat Enemies: Engage in dynamic battles with your enemies.

🧩 Solve Puzzles: Test your critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

🌙 A Dream-like Tale: Uncover a touching, emotional narrative that delves into themes of self-reflection and growth.

🎨 100% Hand-Painted Art: Every visual element in the game is carefully crafted by hand, creating a beautiful, one-of-a-kind experience.

🤝 Team Up with Your Inner Monster: Build a meaningful relationship with Moti, using teamwork, empathy, and courage to overcome every challenge.

THE GAME IS CURRENTLY IN DEVELOPMENT, AND ITS CONTENT MAY CHANGE.

data.short_description: My Monsters is a VR action-adventure with 100% hand-painted art. Enter the dreamlike world of Onirium and team up with Moti, your inner little monster, to battle enemies, solve puzzles, and face inner monsters like anxiety, loneliness and fear, uncovering fragments of a meaningful dreamlike tale.

English*, Portuguese - Brazil*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 9 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR. Supported on Valve Index, Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest 3.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 Skylake or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR. Supported on Valve Index, Meta Quest 2 and Meta Quest 3.
